lines.t: Hi love, haven't heard from you in weeks. Everything ok? Call me when you can.
Right. Message received. Loud and clear.
You have changed. Everyone says it and I keep defending you.
Your father says you are worrying too much. He worries too much. Runs in the family.
Did you get my last one? No rush.
